children: BYD (BYDDY) sold 440,293 vehicles in August, up 17.8% from a year earlier and a fourth consecutive month of rising global sales. Overseas shipments rose 134.5% to 189,466 vehicles.

BYD has pushed into Europe and Southeast Asia as competition and weak consumer spending have squeezed the domestic market. The company generated more revenue outside China than inside it for the first time in the January to June period, with vehicle exports lifting gross margins.

Brazil, BYD's largest market outside China, has become central to that expansion. The company is preparing to launch its first locally produced plug-in hybrid flex-fuel vehicle there, deepening its manufacturing base in Latin America's largest auto market.

title: BYD's Overseas Shipments More Than Doubled in August
